description: This Java class, DefaultIndexInitializationConfig, provides configuration handling for index initialization settings within a MongoDB context. It includes methods to instantiate the config from a Config object, check if index initialization is enabled, and override equality, hash, and string representation methods.

classes.name: DefaultIndexInitializationConfig
classes.description: The main class providing index initialization configuration for MongoDB, encapsulating the enabled/disabled state and related logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance from a Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: isIndexInitializationConfigEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether index initialization is enabled based on the configuration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare configuration instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate a hash based on the enabled flag.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration object.
